_comment: Guardrails: basic rules so the video does not produce unnecessary bugs. Kept as data, not code, so the control app can read and change them without a code push. Each format (shorts, longform) has its own rules. Muse reads this file when writing scene code, and the validator reads it at render time; if it is missing, the built-in defaults in guardrails.py apply.
basic_rules: Use ONLY core GSAP (tl.fromTo, tl.to, tl.set). Do NOT use motionPath, ScrollTrigger, or any other plugin; they are not loaded and the check fails.
Only call prepDraw or dashLen on paths, lines, polylines, circles. Never on <text> elements: text has no length, so fade it in with opacity instead of drawing it on.
Never compute a tween duration from S or E as an absolute time (for example 14.6 - (S + 2.8)). Use a fixed number of seconds, or a relative length such as (E - S - 2).
Every beat's timeline ends with the exit fade and hard kill (added mechanically). Do not write the exit yourself.
All element ids must start with the beat id (%%ID%%-...). Never reference an id you did not define.
Keep everything inside the format's canvas margins. No overflow, no overlap.
No <script> tag in markup. No <!--TIMELINE--> marker.

longform.label: Long-form
longform.prompt:
FORMAT: Long-form. Horizontal 1920x1080, 10 to 15 minutes, built in chapters (5 parts).
- Pace is SLOW, with breathing room. Hold a scene longer so the voice can finish; do not rush. At a chapter boundary, hold the last clip 1s longer so the voice finishes, then leave 0.5s of silence before the next chapter's voice begins.
- BIG TEXT RULE: .hook-line (80px) and .close-line (72px) do NOT wrap. One line holds at most 6 short words (about 40 characters). A full sentence on one line overflows the frame and is cut off. Break long text into MULTIPLE short lines, one div per phrase, stacked vertically. Never put a whole sentence on one big line.
- Titles 60-80px, body 36-44px. The frame is wide: side-by-side elements are fine. Keep everything inside the margins: left 80px, right 1840px, top 80px, bottom 1000px.
- Characters, clothing, and environments must be accurate to the real people, place, and era of the story. Never modernise a historical scene.
- The narration ends on an open question, then 3-5 seconds of silence. Never write a call to action.
- Captions are added later as SRT + burn-in. Do not draw your own captions into the scene.

shorts.label: Shorts
shorts.prompt:
FORMAT: Shorts. Vertical 1080x1920, 30 to 60 seconds.
- Pace is FAST. Hook in the first seconds, big and immediate. No dead air: every beat builds, holds briefly, then exits.
- BIG TEXT RULE: .hook-line (116px) and .close-line (104px) do NOT wrap. One line holds at most 4 short words (about 24 characters). A full sentence on one line overflows the frame and is cut off. Break long text into MULTIPLE short lines, one div per phrase, stacked vertically. Never put a whole sentence on one big line.
- Titles 40-44px, body 28-34px. Keep everything inside the margins: left 40px, right 1040px, top 120px, bottom 1800px.
- Captions are added later in 3-4 word chunks, lower third. Do not draw your own captions into the scene.
